description: This file implements thread-specific data (TSD) management for jemalloc, including initialization, cleanup, thread-local storage handling, and platform-specific thread cleanup routines.

methods.name: tsd_slow_update
methods.description: Updates the state of a thread-specific data object based on current conditions.

methods.name: tsd_data_init
methods.description: Initializes thread-specific data, including rtree context and tcache, with a deterministic or nondeterministic seed.

methods.name: assert_tsd_data_cleanup_done
methods.description: Asserts that the thread-specific data has been properly cleaned up.

methods.name: tsd_data_init_nocleanup
methods.description: Initializes thread-specific data during reincarnation without cleanup.

methods.name: tsd_fetch_slow
methods.description: Fetches or initializes thread-specific data, handling various thread states.

methods.name: malloc_tsd_malloc
methods.description: Allocates memory aligned to cache line size.

methods.name: _malloc_thread_cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup of thread-specific data during thread detach, calling registered cleanup functions.

methods.name: malloc_tsd_cleanup_register
methods.description: Registers a cleanup function to be called during thread cleanup.

methods.name: tsd_do_data_cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup of various thread-specific data components.

methods.name: tsd_cleanup
methods.description: Main destructor for thread-specific data, handling different thread states and cleanup.

methods.name: malloc_tsd_boot0
methods.description: Initializes thread-specific data at thread startup.

methods.name: malloc_tsd_boot1
methods.description: Completes thread-specific data initialization after thread startup.
